question: Can a source-blind GF(2) coefficient program prove that its unseen predictions are or are not identified by own charged observations, and decline unjustified certitude without changing prior scientific data?
hypothesis: For the unrestricted 64-coefficient ANF of six public binary inputs, any 32 distinct charged contexts leave exactly 32 independent binary degrees of freedom. Each uncharged context has both 0 and 1 consistent completions. A source-free linear-algebra certificate must show both completions, never assert unique unseen answers.

numerical_contract.features: 64 ANF monomials over six typed binary input positions; same WSP149 feature order and evaluation
numerical_contract.data: ONLY a provided sequence of 32 distinct fabricated (x,y) observations and WSP149-fitted weights, no owner or source
numerical_contract.model: Provide a second coefficient vector w2 with A*w2=A*w (mod 2), but prediction at requested unobserved context x differs; observed contexts always checked and returned as observed only
numerical_contract.method: Deterministic GF(2) elimination of 33x64 homogeneous equations A*delta=0 plus one new held-row constraint phi(x)*delta=1; w2=w XOR delta. Verify both on all 32 observations and opposite at x
numerical_contract.status: OBSERVED or UNIDENTIFIABLE; neither a causal posterior nor a source truth label
numerical_contract.negative_controls: Reject non-distinct rows, bad label/type, invalid x, wrong weights, fabricated tampering and mis-certified observed context; independent checker recomputes both constraints

boundary: DEVELOPMENT ONLY; mathematical identifiability proof does NOT demonstrate learned operator structure, causality, novelty, intelligence, improved predictive accuracy or native Yggdrasil gains. Never score/replay WSP149 originals or overwrite negative results.
advancement: After source-free test/qualification, separately preregister a new FIRST-USE independent operator-learning experiment with frozen strong fully trained CART and symbolic controls, same action/info/capacity/compute budgets, cold retention, negative/off-family, unseen role binding and intervention tests, per-world CI. No experiment first-use under this WSP150 prereg.
